title: Rava bar Mesharshiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Nazir 40b, challenging Rava. Hyman suggests that it is an abbreviation לרב״א, meaning Rav Ashi, for one cannot say that he would challenge Rava with the refutation that Rava of Barnish raised against Rav Ashi. He offers this as a resolution of Seder HaDorot’s difficulty.

notes.text: The consulted Nazir passage reads ‘to Rava.’ Hyman proposes reading the expression as an abbreviation for ‘to Rav Ashi.’
